name: Fire Bolt
tooltip: Hurls a bolt of ash-fire at a foe (reach 7), dealing 16-24 fire damage. Cost: 8 mana, CD: 30.
flavor: The first lesson of the border academies: dry thatch and wet men burn at the same rate once the pitch catches.

name: Fireball
tooltip: Launches an explosive sphere at the ground (reach 8, radius 2), dealing 18-28 fire damage. Cost: 14, CD: 40.
flavor: Siege engineers spend three days building a trebuchet; a battle-mage spends fourteen mana and an afternoon's patience.

name: Flame Burst
tooltip: Splits into up to 3 fiery shards within radius 3.5 (reach 7), dealing 12-18 fire damage each. Cost: 12, CD: 35.
flavor: When the kiln is over-stoked, the bricks themselves become shrapnel.

name: Ignite
tooltip: Sets a foe ablaze (reach 6), inflicting burn (2) for 6s. Cost: 8 mana, CD: 30.
flavor: It does not kill quickly, which makes it unpopular with duelists and favored by quartermasters.

name: Frost Bolt
tooltip: Strikes a foe with river-ice (reach 7) for 12-18 water damage and slows for 8s. Cost: 8, CD: 30.
flavor: The winter ford claims more boots than the gnolls ever did.

name: Ice Storm
tooltip: Pelts an area with sleet (reach 8, radius 2.5) for 10-16 damage, slowing foes for 6s. Cost: 16, CD: 45.
flavor: A brief, localized January borrowed from the northern crags.

name: Chain Frost
tooltip: Bounces across 4 foes in radius 3.5 (reach 7) for 9-14 damage, slowing for 4s. Cost: 14, CD: 40.
flavor: Misery loves company; hypothermia insists upon it.

name: Healing
tooltip: Mends an ally's wounds (reach 7), restoring 30-45 HP. Cost: 10 mana, CD: 30.
flavor: Knits torn flesh with the cold, indifferent efficiency of a cobbler's awl.
cast_line: Get up; your pay isn't spent.

name: Healing Rain
tooltip: Showers a 3-radius area (reach 8), restoring 14-22 HP to allies within. Cost: 18 mana, CD: 50.
flavor: Tastes of peat moss and iron, but washes the coagulated dust from the eyes.
cast_line: Drink before the mud takes it.

name: Lightning
tooltip: Strikes a foe with a high-voltage arc (reach 8) for 24-34 air damage. Cost: 12 mana, CD: 35.
flavor: Leaves a smell of copper coins and boiled wool in the wet marsh air.

name: Chain Lightning
tooltip: Arcs across 4 targets within radius 3.5 (reach 7), dealing 14-22 air damage. Cost: 16, CD: 40.
flavor: Iron mail is a wonderful invention right up until the sky decides to speak.

name: Haste
tooltip: Quickens an ally's stride and swing (reach 7) with haste for 25s. Cost: 12 mana, CD: 30.
flavor: The heart beats twice as fast, borrowing tomorrow's vigor to pay today's butcher bill.
cast_line: Double-time, or die in the mud!

name: Gale
tooltip: Buffets a 3-radius area (reach 8) for 8-12 air damage and slows foes for 5s. Cost: 12, CD: 40.
flavor: A sudden coastal squall that fills helmets with grit and ruins bowstrings.
cast_line: Against the teeth of the wind!

name: Wind Ward
tooltip: Sheathes the caster in whirling air, granting a 35-point shield for 45s. Cost: 8 mana, CD: 30.
flavor: Arrows do not miss; they simply decide they have urgent business three inches to the left.

name: Rock Throw
tooltip: Hurls a jagged chunk of granite at a foe (reach 7) for 18-26 earth damage. Cost: 9, CD: 32.
flavor: Six years of classical academy Latin, culminating in throwing a very large brick.

name: Stone Curse
tooltip: Calcifies a foe (reach 6), petrifying them into stone for 5s. Cost: 16 mana, CD: 40.
flavor: For five quiet seconds, even the most fanatical raider becomes a garden ornament.
cast_line: Be still and wait for the chisel.

name: Stone Skin
tooltip: Hardens an ally's flesh (reach 7) with a 50-point earth shield for 45s. Cost: 10, CD: 30.
flavor: The skin turns the color of wet slate and itches abominably, yet blades bounce off.

name: Poison Cloud
tooltip: Fills a 2.5-radius area (reach 8) with toxic marsh gas, poisoning (1) for 12s. Cost: 12, CD: 40.
flavor: Distilled from what bubbles up when you step on a bloated horse in the Redmarsh.

name: Quake
tooltip: Ruptures the ground (reach 7, radius 3.5), dealing 20-30 earth damage. Cost: 22 mana, CD: 60.
flavor: Foundations are merely polite agreements between mason and bedrock; both can be revoked.
cast_line: Let the cellar swallow the hall!

name: Blessing
tooltip: Steadies an ally's hand and spirit (reach 7), granting bless for 60s. Cost: 10 mana, CD: 30.
flavor: Not a prayer to the gods—who are notoriously busy—but a cold alignment of nerve and iron.
cast_line: Steady the hand, narrow the eye.

name: Weaken
tooltip: Saps a foe's sinews (reach 7), inflicting weaken for 30s. Cost: 8 mana, CD: 30.
flavor: Suddenly the sword weighs forty pounds and the shield feels like a wet mattress.

name: Resurrect
tooltip: Calls a fallen combatant back from a corpse (reach 6). Cost: 30 mana, CD: 75.
flavor: Death on the frontier is rarely a permanent discharge; the quartermaster still has your contract.

name: Corpse Burst
tooltip: Detonates a corpse (reach 7, radius 2.5), dealing 18-26 astral damage. Cost: 14, CD: 50.
flavor: An unsentimental recycling of fallen vanguard assets.

name: Meditation
tooltip: Centers the mind to restore 12 mana to the caster. Cost: 0 mana, CD: 250.
flavor: Three deep breaths of gun-smoke and blood, counting backwards from a hundred.

name: Meteor
tooltip: Calls down a molten crag (reach 8, radius 3) for 32-48 damage and burn (4) for 8s. Cost: 26, CD: 70.
flavor: When diplomacy, archery, and heavy infantry have all failed to make the point.

name: Inferno
tooltip: Engulfs up to 5 foes in radius 4 (reach 7) for 22-34 fire damage each. Cost: 20 mana, CD: 45.
flavor: Turns a defensive shield-wall into a communal Dutch oven.

name: Blizzard
tooltip: Unleashes a freezing gale (reach 8, radius 3.5) for 20-30 damage, slowing for 10s. Cost: 24, CD: 65.
flavor: The kind of frost that snaps pine trunks like dry macaroni.

name: Thunderstorm
tooltip: Strikes 4 foes in radius 4 (reach 8) with 26-38 air damage each. Cost: 22 mana, CD: 50.
flavor: Four bolts, four blackened craters, and a sudden shortage of officers.
cast_line: Count the seconds to the thunder!

name: Iron Skin
tooltip: Encases the caster in living plate, granting a 100-point shield for 60s. Cost: 18 mana, CD: 60.
flavor: For one minute, you are an anvil, and the rest of the world is merely a poorly tempered hammer.

name: Acid Rain
tooltip: Corrosive downpour (reach 8, radius 3.5) dealing 14-20 damage and poison (2) for 16s. Cost: 20, CD: 55.
flavor: Pits polished steel, blinds warhorses, and ruins the heraldry on the banners.

name: Mana Burn
tooltip: Ignites a foe's internal aether (reach 7), dealing 25-40 astral damage. Cost: 15 mana, CD: 40.
flavor: Boils the uncast syllables right on the enemy sorcerer's tongue.

name: Time Warp
tooltip: Bends the local hour around the caster, granting haste for 40s. Cost: 25 mana, CD: 80.
flavor: To the rest of the battlefield, you are a blur; to yourself, everyone else is wading through cold molasses.

name: Shield Bash
tooltip: Slams your shield into an adjacent foe (reach 1), dealing 14-20 physical damage and stunning for 2s. Cost: 10 mana, CD: 25.
flavor: A heavy oak rim to the jaw settles arguments faster than any royal writ.

name: Cleave Arc
tooltip: Sweeps your weapon in a wide front arc (reach 2), hitting up to 3 foes for 18-26 physical damage. Cost: 14 mana, CD: 30.
flavor: Border pikemen learn early to swing wide when briar-hounds hunt in packs.

name: Rampart Stance
tooltip: Plants your boots firmly for 8s, granting +18 Armor and +25% Block Chance while reducing move speed. Cost: 12 mana, CD: 45.
flavor: Stand like an Alder Bridge piling and let the current break itself against your ribs.

name: Hamstring Cut
tooltip: Slices low across a target's leg (reach 1), dealing 12-18 damage and slowing movement by 45% for 5s. Cost: 9 mana, CD: 28.
flavor: A crippled deserter runs no faster than a wagon with a snapped axle.

name: Rallying Horn
tooltip: Sounds a brass war-horn (radius 5), granting nearby allies +12% Damage and +10 Armor for 10s. Cost: 18 mana, CD: 60.
flavor: Nothing steadies shaky knees like knowing the captain is still vertical.

name: Sunder Plate
tooltip: Crushes enemy armor with a downward blow (reach 1), dealing 20-28 damage and reducing Armor by 12 for 6s. Cost: 15 mana, CD: 35.
flavor: One good dent in a breastplate turns royal steel into a suffocating cage.

name: Vanguard Charge
tooltip: Rushes up to 6 tiles toward an enemy, dealing 16-24 physical damage and knocking them back 1 tile. Cost: 16 mana, CD: 40.
flavor: Closing forty paces before the archers reload is half the battle.

name: Grit Through Pain
tooltip: Shrugs off fresh wounds, restoring 28-36 HP and cleansing bleed effects immediately. Cost: 14 mana, CD: 50.
flavor: Spit out the blood, tighten your belt, and finish the shift.

name: Whirlwind Maul
tooltip: Spins violently (radius 2), striking all surrounding enemies twice for 15-22 damage per hit. Cost: 22 mana, CD: 55.
flavor: When surrounded in a narrow alley, turn yourself into a threshing machine.

name: Executioner's Blow
tooltip: Delivers a massive overhead strike (reach 1) for 34-46 physical damage, dealing +50% to foes below 30% HP. Cost: 24 mana, CD: 60.
flavor: No appeals, no ledgers—just a clean parting of head and shoulders.

name: Bodkin Shot
tooltip: Fires a heavy armor-piercing arrow (reach 9), dealing 18-25 physical damage and ignoring 10 Armor. Cost: 10 mana, CD: 25.
flavor: Forged square and needle-sharp to punch straight through brigandine links.

name: Volley of Reeds
tooltip: Rains arrows onto a target area (reach 9, radius 2), dealing 14-20 physical damage to all foes within. Cost: 16 mana, CD: 38.
flavor: Why pick one target when three dozen shafts darken the whole marsh?

name: Caltrop Scatter
tooltip: Tosses iron spikes onto the ground (reach 5, radius 2) for 12s, slowing foes by 40% and dealing 8 bleed/s. Cost: 11 mana, CD: 35.
flavor: Four-pronged border iron always lands with one tooth pointing straight up.

name: Pinning Arrow
tooltip: Nails a foe's boot to the dirt (reach 8), dealing 14-19 damage and rooting them in place for 3s. Cost: 12 mana, CD: 32.
flavor: A stout ash shaft through the instep ruins any charger's momentum.

name: Smoke Flask
tooltip: Hurls an ash-filled clay pot at your feet (radius 2), granting +35% Dodge Chance for 6s. Cost: 13 mana, CD: 42.
flavor: Poachers vanish into gray soot faster than hounds can catch the wind.

name: Viper-Bile Tip
tooltip: Coats your next 3 shots in bog-venom, adding 15 poison damage over 4s to each hit. Cost: 14 mana, CD: 36.
flavor: Scraped fresh from Redmarsh reed-blinds; even a scratch turns black by dusk.

name: Hawk-Eye Focus
tooltip: Steadies your breathing for 8s, granting +20 Accuracy, +15% Crit Chance, and +2 bow reach. Cost: 15 mana, CD: 48.
flavor: Count the heartbeat, hold the draw, and let the wind carry the fletching.

name: Evasive Vault
tooltip: Leaps backward 4 tiles while firing a quick parting shot for 12-16 physical damage. Cost: 14 mana, CD: 34.
flavor: Never let a heavy axeman get close enough to grab your bow-stave.

name: Piercing Line
tooltip: Looses a full-draw greatbow shaft in a straight line (reach 10), hitting every foe for 22-30 damage. Cost: 20 mana, CD: 45.
flavor: Drawn to the ear, an ashwood shaft punches through two men and a plank shield.

name: Heartseeker
tooltip: Takes careful aim at a single distant target (reach 10), dealing 36-48 damage with +30% Crit Chance. Cost: 24 mana, CD: 58.
flavor: One arrow from the ridge ends a captain's speech mid-syllable.

name: Cinder Lance
tooltip: Fires a compressed beam of white-hot ash (reach 8), dealing 20-28 fire damage and igniting for 6/s. Cost: 14 mana, CD: 30.
flavor: Concentrated foundry heat melts bronze buckles before the wearer even screams.

name: Brine Frost
tooltip: Freezes coastal spray over a target area (reach 7, radius 2), dealing 16-22 cold damage and slowing 40% for 4s. Cost: 15 mana, CD: 34.
flavor: Sea-salt lowers the freezing point until ice bites straight into bone.

name: Arcane Shackle
tooltip: Binds a foe in glowing chalk runes (reach 7), silencing spellcasting and slowing movement for 4s. Cost: 13 mana, CD: 36.
flavor: Academy wardens use these sigils to keep rogue apprentices from burning the library.

name: Static Arc
tooltip: Discharges jagged copper sparks (reach 6), dealing 18-26 lightning damage; deals +30% in water or mud. Cost: 12 mana, CD: 28.
flavor: Wet boots and iron mail turn every ford into a death trap.

name: Mirror Ward
tooltip: Surrounds yourself with refracting glass shards for 7s, absorbing 35 damage and reflecting 12 back. Cost: 18 mana, CD: 46.
flavor: Smelted river-quartz turns stray arrows back toward the fools who loosed them.

name: Peat-Gas Blast
tooltip: Ignites subterranean swamp fumes (reach 7, radius 2), dealing 22-30 fire damage and knocking foes back. Cost: 19 mana, CD: 42.
flavor: Every Redmarsh peat-cutter knows a single spark turns a quiet ditch into thunder.

name: Siphon Ley
tooltip: Draws ambient magic from a target (reach 7), dealing 14-20 arcane damage and restoring 20 Mana. Cost: 6 mana, CD: 32.
flavor: Why carry heavy mana draughts when enemy casters are full to bursting?

name: Slag Torrent
tooltip: Sprays molten cinders in a short cone (reach 4), dealing 24-34 fire damage and melting 8 Armor. Cost: 21 mana, CD: 44.
flavor: Borrowed straight from the royal gunpowder foundries of Crown and Ember.

name: Aether Step
tooltip: Steps instantly through a tear in the air up to 5 tiles away, leaving a blinding flash behind. Cost: 16 mana, CD: 38.
flavor: A scholarly shortcut for avoiding heavy axes without ruining good velvet.

name: Vitrify
tooltip: Superheats the ground under an enemy (reach 8), dealing 38-50 fire damage and turning sand or ash to glass. Cost: 28 mana, CD: 62.
flavor: The Sovereign's court pyromancers left entire city squares glazed like pottery.

name: Raise Peat-Thrall
tooltip: Animates a nearby corpse into a bog-rotted thrall for 25s with 65 HP and 12 melee damage. Cost: 16 mana, CD: 30.
flavor: The mud of Thornvael never lets go of a body without putting it back to work.

name: Marrow Dart
tooltip: Fires a splintered bone shard (reach 8), dealing 15-22 physical/shadow damage and healing you for 8 HP. Cost: 10 mana, CD: 24.
flavor: Every battlefield provides endless ammunition once the fighting starts.

name: Grave Chill
tooltip: Releases tomb-cold mist around you (radius 3), dealing 14-20 cold damage and slowing attack speed 25% for 5s. Cost: 14 mana, CD: 35.
flavor: The damp cellar air of an old ossuary clings to living joints like lead.

name: Leech Tether
tooltip: Links to a foe (reach 6) for 4s, draining 10 HP per second and transferring it to your lowest-HP minion. Cost: 15 mana, CD: 38.
flavor: Fresh blood keeps old sinew stitching together long past its due date.

name: Bone Cage
tooltip: Erupts jagged ribs from the soil around a target (reach 7), trapping them in place for 3.5s. Cost: 16 mana, CD: 40.
flavor: Even beneath paved roads, old bones lie close enough to answer a sharp call.

name: Putrid Miasma
tooltip: Curses an area with rotting swamp-fumes (reach 7, radius 2) for 6s, dealing 12 poison damage/s and reducing healing. Cost: 18 mana, CD: 42.
flavor: Bottled straight from the quicklime trenches outside Redmarsh.

name: Ossuary Shield
tooltip: Orbits 3 bleached skulls around you for 10s, each blocking one hit and dealing 10 damage on shatter. Cost: 17 mana, CD: 45.
flavor: Former tax-collectors make surprisingly stubborn bodyguards once stripped of flesh.

name: Soul Tithe
tooltip: Marks a weakened foe (reach 7) for 6s; if they die while marked, you gain 25 Mana and summon a wraith. Cost: 12 mana, CD: 36.
flavor: The Crown collects silver; the grave collects everything else.

name: Frenzied Dead
tooltip: Drives all active minions into a bloodlust for 7s, granting +30% Attack Speed and +25% Movement Speed. Cost: 20 mana, CD: 50.
flavor: Remind them how much they hated the living before they drowned.

name: Mass Exhumation
tooltip: Raises up to 3 corpses in a wide area (radius 4) simultaneously as armored skeletal footmen for 30s. Cost: 32 mana, CD: 70.
flavor: Why pay mercenary wages when an entire forgotten skirmish sleeps underfoot?

name: Barbed Shaft
tooltip: Looses a jagged hunting arrow (reach 9) for 16-24 physical damage and inflicts 4s venom-bleed. Cost: 13 mana, CD: 30.
flavor: Poachers notch the bodkin backwards with bog-resin so every step the quarry takes saws deeper.
cast_line: Let it tear on the pull.

name: Gale Pin
tooltip: Drives a wind-lashed arrow (reach 10) for 26-36 physical damage and slows the target for 4s. Cost: 20 mana, CD: 46.
flavor: Fletched with storm-kite quills, the shaft whistles flat across the marsh and pins boots to the mud.

name: Quicklime Cloud
tooltip: Ruptures a caustic ash cloud on the ground (radius 2.5) for 16-24 earth damage and weakens foes for 6s. Cost: 18 mana, CD: 42.
flavor: Parish sextons scatter slaked lime over mass graves; a necromancer merely throws the sack while the wind blows.

name: Bone Splinter
tooltip: Shatters a cursed femur into astral shards hitting up to 4 foes within 4 tiles for 20-30 damage. Cost: 22 mana, CD: 48.
flavor: Dry marrow holds an old grudge better than iron, and splits cleanly toward anything still warm.

name: Rite of Ash
tooltip: Detonates a fallen corpse in an ash-fire blast (radius 3) for 36-52 fire damage and 4s burn. Cost: 28 mana, CD: 60.
flavor: The First Watch burned their dead before sunset so nothing could raise them; the Rite of Ash makes the pyre do the killing.
